title: Ohm Brew Double Brew Pineapple Orange & Mango 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Ohm Brew Double Brew Pineapple Orange and Mango brings a taste of the tropics to your tank. The bold, tangy sweetness of Pineapple sets the stage, followed by the citrus brightness of zesty Orange. The exhale introduces the lush, creamy nectar of ripe Mango, tying the fruits together into a harmonious and exotic blend. Formulated with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this e-liquid is versatile enough for both MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) and RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) vaping. It pairs perfectly with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.6ohm, ensuring consistent flavour and vapour production. The nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Double Brew by the renowned UK mixologists Ohm Brew is a collection of double-concentrated nicotine salts designed to deliver maximum flavour intensity. Known as "bar salts," these e-liquids are formulated with twice the flavour concentrate of standard blends, offering an intensely bold and vivid taste profile. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Double Brew provides a smooth and satisfying vape experience.
